title: Upload a file in project
content: To upload a file, go to your home page or press Project in your sidebar, click in the project you want to upload,  then go in the file tab in your project, click Add File button, select your file, and confirm. We currently only support docx, pdf, txt,json file type. If you don't have a project i can guide you to create or join one.

title: Reset password
content: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page. Check your email for the reset code.

title: Update profile
content: To update your project, click on your avatar in the upper right corner of your screen. You can update your profile there.

title: Change password
content: To change your password, click on your avatar in the upper right corner of your screen, switch to the tab change password. Enter your old password, new password, confirm password and confirm.

title: Create project
content: To create a project, in the sidebar on the left of your screen press project, then press the create new project , enter all the information and press create project.

title: Create public request
content: To create a public request, in the sidebar on the left of your screen press My Request, then press Create New Request button, choose Public Request type,then enter all the field and the file you want to translate and press create request. We now only support json,txt,docx and pdf file type. Other will be update in the future.

title: Create private request
content: To create a private request, in the sidebar on the left of your screen press My Request, then press Create New Request button, choose Private Request type,then choose the person you want to assign the request, then enter the other field and the file you want to translate and press create request. After that you will be redirected to payment the deposit.We now only support json,txt,docx and pdf file type. Other will be update in the future.

title: Update project
content: To update a project, go to your project through your home or press in Project in your sidebar, then click in Edit Project button in your project, change the information of your project then click Update Project.

title: Delete project
content: To delete a project, go to your project through your home or press in Project in your sidebar, then click in Delete Project button in your project, and confirm.

title: Add user to project
content: To add a member to your project, first you have to be the project owner or have a role with Manage Member permission to do this, if you have it go to your project through your home or press in Project in your sidebar, then go to Member tab in your project, click add user button, there will be a search bar appear, enter email or username of the person you want to add in and press search, it will appear an user in there, if it the person you want to add, click Add To Project, that user will be added into your project.

title: Remove member from project
content: To remove a member from your project, first you have to be the project owner or have a role with Manage Member permission to do this, if you have it go to your project through your home or press in Project in your sidebar, then go to Member tab in your project, in there you will see a list of member , search for the member you want to remove and click remove member, and them confirm.

title: Create project role
content: To create a project role, first you have to be the project owner or have a role with Manage Roles or Manage Member permission to do this, if you have it go to your project through your home or press in Project in your sidebar, then go to Roles tab in your project, in there you will see a table with all the roles in your project and a create role button, click create role button and enter project name and choose a permission for it, then confirm. Do you want me to show how to assign role to member ?

title: Edit project role
content: To edit project role, first you have to be the project owner or have a role with Manage Roles or Manage Member permission to do this, if you have it go to your project through your home or press in Project in your sidebar, then go to Roles tab in your project,  in there you will see a table with all the roles in your project,click in Edit button in the role you want to edit, change the information you want to change and click confirm.

title: Delete project role
content: To edit project role, first you have to be the project owner or have a role with Manage Roles or Manage Member permission to do this, if you have it go to your project through your home or press in Project in your sidebar, then go to Roles tab in your project,  in there you will see a table with all the roles in your project,click in Delete button in the role you want to delete, then confirm.

title: Assign role to member
content: To assign role to member, first you have to be the project owner or have a role with Manage Roles or Manage Member permission to do this, if you have it go to your project through your home or press in Project in your sidebar, then go to Roles tab in your project,  in there you will see a member list ,click in Assign role button and choose the role you want to assign to that member, then confirm.

title: Remove role from member
content: To assign role to member, first you have to be the project owner or have a role with Manage Roles or Manage Member permission to do this, if you have it go to your project through your home or press in Project in your sidebar, then go to Roles tab in your project,  in there you will see a member list ,click in Assign role button and a modal pop up in there you will see the roles that member have, then click x in the role.

title: Edit request
content: To update a request, then in sidebar on the left of your screen press My Request, then press Create New Request button, choose Public Request type,then enter all the field and the file you want to translate and press create request. We now only support json,txt,docx and pdf file type. Other will be update in the future.

title: Register for public request
content: To register a public request, go to public request through your sidebar, there will be a list of public request , choose the one that suit you , click in and press Register for this request.

title: Withdraw
content: To make a withdraw, click Wallet in your sidebar, in there will be a Withdraw button, click in enter the amount money you want to withdraw and your paypal email, make sure you not enter the wrong email. After that the withdraw will be process in about 24h.

title: View transaction history
content: To see your transaction history, click Transaction History in your sidebar.

title: Add translation
content: To add translation , go to your project, go in translation tab, choose the file you want to add translation, enter your translation then click save.

title: Delete file
content: To delete a file, go to your project, go to file tab, click in dot in the file you want to delete, click delete button then confirm.

title: Send comment
content: To send comment in a discussion, go to your project, go to discussion tab, click in the discussion you want to send comment, click view and enter comment then press post comment.

title: Update comment
content: To update comment in a discussion, go to your project, go to discussion tab, click in the discussion that have the comment that you want to update, click view and edit the comment you needed, then confirm.

title: Delete comment
content: To delete comment in a discussion, go to your project, go to discussion tab, click in the discussion that have the comment that you want to delete, click view and and click delete the comment you want to delete, then confirm.

title: Create Discussion
content: To create a discussion, first you need to be the project owner or have a role with Manage Discussions permission. If you have if, then go to your project, then go in Discussion tab, in there you will see list of discussion and create new discussion button, enter title and description then press create discussion.

title: Update Discussion
content: To update a discussion, first you need to be the project owner or have a role with Manage Discussions permission. If you have if, then go to your project, then go in Discussion tab, in there you will see list of discussion , click in the action button, in there it will have edit button, change the information you need to change then press save.

title: Review Translation
content: To review translation, go to your project, go to commit tab, there will be a list of translation need to be review, click review and see the content, then approve or reject it.

title: Create group
content: To create a group, go to your project, go to group tab, there will be list of group have been created, click in create new group button, enter group name and add member then confirm.

title: Edit group
content: To edit a group, go to your project, go to group tab, there will be list of group have been created, click in edit button in the group you want to edit, modify group name and member then confirm.

title: Delete group
content: To delete a group, go to your project, go to group tab, there will be list of group have been created, click in delete button in the group you want to delete, then confirm.

title: Add member to group
content: To add member to a group, go to your project, go to group tab, if you don't have any group create one, in there you can add member to your group, id you already have one click edit in the group you want to add, then add more member to that group.

title: Create task
content: To create task, go to your project, go to task tab, enter title, description, choose the file and the part for the task, choose the language, assign to a member or a group, and choose the due date, then confirm.
